description: New and updated how-to guides for Xero sync and Smart Match bank reconciliation

new_guides.title: Complete Guide to Xero Sync
new_guides.content:
Complete Guide to Xero Sync

A step-by-step walkthrough covering the entire Xero integration from connection to ongoing sync management. Follow this guide in order for initial setup, or jump to specific sections for reference.

Important: Xero integration is only available on Advanced and Pro Audit subscription plans. Upgrade your plan before proceeding.

Overview: How Xero Sync Works

PayTrade's Xero integration provides two-way sync between your PayTrade and Xero accounts. Data flows in both directions:

  • PayTrade to Xero: Payment claims, invoices, bills, and payments you create in PayTrade are exported to Xero as invoices, bills, and payments.
  • Xero to PayTrade: Invoices, bills, and payments created in Xero are imported into PayTrade as payment claims and payments.

Sync happens in three ways: manually (you click Sync), automatically (daily scheduled sync at 1:00 PM UTC), and in real-time (Xero webhooks push changes as they happen).

Step 1: Connect Xero

Follow the "Connecting Xero to PayTrade" guide for the initial OAuth connection. In summary:

1
Navigate to Integrations

Go to Integrations in the sidebar menu.

2
Click Connect Xero

Click the Xero connection button on the Integration List page.

3
Authorise in Xero

Sign in to Xero and grant PayTrade access to your Xero organisation.

4
Return to PayTrade

You will be redirected back to PayTrade automatically. Your Xero connection status will show as "Connected".

Note: PayTrade automatically refreshes your Xero access token every 23 hours. If your token expires (e.g., you revoked access in Xero), PayTrade will prompt you to re-authorise.

Step 2: Configure Settings & Account Mappings

Follow the "Xero Account Mapping and Settings" guide for detailed instructions. Key tasks:

  • Chart of Accounts: Map your PayTrade financial activities to Xero account codes (invoice code, bill code, retention codes, liability codes).
  • Tax Rates: Set default invoice and bill tax codes for sync.
  • Tracking Categories: Select which Xero tracking categories represent PayTrade projects and contracts.
  • Sync Preferences: Choose whether synced items arrive as Draft or Approved in each direction.
  • Reference Format: Customise the reference prefix for synced documents.
  • Webhook Wait Time: Set how long the system waits before processing webhook events (0-60 minutes).

Step 3: Map Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects & Contracts

Follow the "Mapping Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects and Contracts in Xero" guide for detailed instructions. This is the onboarding wizard:

1
Map Bank Accounts

Link your Xero bank accounts to PayTrade Cash Accounts, Project Trust Accounts (PTA), or Retention Trust Accounts (RTA).

2
Map Contacts

Link Xero contacts to PayTrade clients and suppliers. Contacts must be mapped before invoices referencing them can sync.

3
Map Projects

Map a Xero tracking category to represent PayTrade projects. Each project maps to a tracking category option.

4
Map Contracts

Map a Xero tracking category to represent PayTrade contracts. Each contract maps to a tracking category option.

5
Activate

Once all mappings are complete, set the integration to Active status.

Step 4: Sync Invoices and Bills

Follow the "Syncing Invoices and Bills with Xero" guide for the complete process.

PayTrade to Xero (Export)

  1. Create a payment claim in PayTrade (receivable = invoice, billable = bill).
  2. Navigate to Xero Invoices or Xero Bills on the Xero Dashboard.
  3. Find the claim on the PayTrade tab and click "Sync to Xero".
  4. The system validates mappings (contact, project, contract, account codes) and creates the invoice/bill in Xero.
  5. The item appears on the Mapped tab with a link to the Xero record.

Xero to PayTrade (Import)

  1. Create an invoice or bill in Xero with the correct tracking categories (project + contract).
  2. Navigate to Xero Invoices or Xero Bills on the Xero Dashboard.
  3. Find the item on the Xero tab and click "Sync to PayTrade".
  4. The system validates tracking categories and creates a payment claim in PayTrade.
  5. The item appears on the Mapped tab.

Step 5: Sync Payments

Follow the "Xero Payment Synchronisation" guide for the complete process.

  • PayTrade to Xero: Payments recorded against claims in PayTrade are exported to Xero as payments against the mapped invoice/bill.
  • Xero to PayTrade: Payments recorded in Xero are imported into PayTrade as payment records against the mapped claim.
  • Retention: Retention payments sync automatically with their own account codes.
  • Special cases: Part payments, overpayments, credit notes, and pay-less-full scenarios are all handled automatically with appropriate error logs when manual action is needed.

Step 6: Monitor Sync Activity

Follow the "Understanding Xero Sync Logs and Error Resolution" guide for detailed troubleshooting.

  • The Xero Dashboard shows sync statistics: Synced vs. Pending counts for each entity type.
  • The Sync Log table at the bottom shows all recent sync events with status (Succeeded, Warning, Failed).
  • Click any log entry to see the full details including a side-by-side comparison of PayTrade and Xero records.
  • Failed entries have a "Resolve" button that guides you to fix the issue.

Ongoing Sync: What Happens Automatically

MechanismWhenWhat It Does
Daily Scheduler1:00 PM UTC dailyFull refresh of accounts, contacts, projects, contracts, and invoices for all active integrations
WebhooksReal-timeXero sends events when contacts or invoices are created/updated. Events are queued and processed after the configured wait time.
Token RefreshEvery 23 hoursKeeps your Xero connection alive without manual re-authentication.

Integration Status States

Your Xero integration can be in one of the following states:

StatusMeaning
Connected (Pending)OAuth authorisation complete, but settings and mappings are not yet configured. Complete the onboarding wizard to activate.
ActiveFully configured and syncing. Daily scheduler and webhooks are operational.
PausedTemporarily stopped. All mappings are preserved but no sync occurs. Useful during data cleanup or account restructuring.
DisconnectedXero access revoked or connection removed. Mappings are preserved. The integration moves to the Archived list.
DeletedPermanently removed. All mapping data is deleted.

Managing Your Connection

From the Integration List page, you can:

  • Pause: Temporarily stop all sync without losing mappings. Useful during data cleanup.
  • Unpause: Resume sync after a pause.
  • Disconnect: Remove the Xero connection. Mappings are preserved and the integration moves to Archived.
  • Delete: Permanently remove the integration and all mapping data.
  • Re-connect: If Xero prompts for re-authentication, follow the OAuth flow again.

Related Guides

  • "Connecting Xero to PayTrade" — Initial connection and OAuth flow
  • "Xero Account Mapping and Settings" — Chart of accounts, tax rates, tracking categories, sync preferences
  • "Mapping Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects and Contracts in Xero" — The 3-tab mapping process for each entity type
  • "Syncing Invoices and Bills with Xero" — Exporting and importing invoices and bills
  • "Xero Payment Synchronisation" — Payment sync including retention, overpayments, and credit notes
  • "Understanding Xero Sync Logs and Error Resolution" — Reading sync logs and fixing errors

new_guides.title: Xero Account Mapping and Settings
new_guides.content:
Xero Account Mapping and Settings

Configure your chart of accounts, tax rates, tracking categories, and sync preferences before syncing data between PayTrade and Xero.

Important: Complete these settings before attempting to sync invoices or bills. Missing account codes or tax rates will cause sync errors.

Getting to Xero Settings

1
Open the Xero Dashboard

Navigate to Integrations in the sidebar, then click on your Xero connection to open the Xero Dashboard.

2
Click Settings

Click "Settings" on the Xero Dashboard or navigate directly to Xero Settings.

Chart of Account Mappings

Map each PayTrade financial activity to a specific Xero account code. These codes tell Xero which ledger accounts to use when syncing.

SettingPurposeExample
Invoice CodeRevenue account for receivable invoices200 - Sales Revenue
Bill CodeExpense account for payable bills400 - Cost of Sales
Retention Payable RetainedAccount for retention amounts held (payable)500 - Retention Held
Retention Payable ReleaseAccount for retention amounts released (payable)502 - Retention Released
Retention Receivable RetainedAccount for retention amounts held (receivable)503 - Retention Receivable Held
Retention Receivable ReleaseAccount for retention amounts released (receivable)504 - Retention Receivable Released
Liability Payable CodePayable liabilities during defects period501 - Current Liability
Liability Receivable CodeReceivable liabilities during defects period506 - Receivable Liability
Tip: If the account code you need doesn't exist in Xero, you can create a new Xero account directly from this screen by specifying the Account Type, Code, and Name.

Tax Rate Configuration

1
Set Invoice Tax Code

Choose the default tax rate for invoices synced to Xero (e.g., GST on Income 10%).

2
Set Bill Tax Code

Choose the default tax rate for bills synced to Xero (e.g., GST on Expenses 10%).

You can also create new tax rates with custom components, compound tax support, and specific report tax types (Input, Output, None, Exempt).

Tracking Categories

Tracking categories in Xero are used to categorise transactions by project and contract. PayTrade uses two:

1
Project Tracking Category

Select the Xero tracking category that represents PayTrade projects. Each PayTrade project will map to an option within this category.

2
Contract Tracking Category

Select the Xero tracking category that represents PayTrade contracts. Each contract will map to an option within this category.

Important: You cannot use the same tracking category for both projects and contracts. They must be different categories.
Tip: If the tracking category doesn't exist yet, you can create it directly from Settings.

Sync Preferences

Control whether items arrive as Draft or Approved in each direction:

DirectionSettingOptions
PayTrade to XeroInvoice sync statusDraft or Approved
PayTrade to XeroBill sync statusDraft or Approved
PayTrade to XeroPayment sync statusDraft or Approved
Xero to PayTradeInvoice sync statusDraft or Approved
Xero to PayTradeBill sync statusDraft or Approved
Xero to PayTradePayment sync statusDraft or Approved
Tip: Use Draft when you want to review synced items before they are finalised. Use Approved for a fully automated workflow.

Other Settings

  • Reference Format: Customise the reference prefix for synced documents (e.g., "PT-INV-" for invoices).
  • Webhook Wait Time: Set a delay (0–60 minutes) before processing webhook events from Xero. A short delay batches rapid changes; setting it to 0 processes events immediately.
Note: Once all settings are configured, proceed to "Mapping Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects and Contracts in Xero" to complete the onboarding wizard.

new_guides.title: Mapping Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects and Contracts in Xero
new_guides.content:
Mapping Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects and Contracts in Xero

Link your Xero entities to their PayTrade counterparts. This is required before any invoice, bill, or payment can sync.

How Entity Mapping Works

Each mapping screen follows the same three-tab pattern:

  • Mapped Tab: Shows successfully linked entity pairs. Use "Auto Map" to automatically match by name, or "Unmap" to break a link.
  • PayTrade Tab: Shows PayTrade entities that are not yet mapped. You can "Manual Map" to link to an existing Xero entity, or "Sync to Xero" to create the entity in Xero automatically.
  • Xero Tab: Shows Xero entities not yet mapped. You can "Manual Map" to link to an existing PayTrade entity, or "Sync to PayTrade" to create the entity in PayTrade automatically.

Each tab includes a search field to quickly find specific entities.

Bank Account Mapping

Navigate to Xero Bank Accounts on the Xero Dashboard.

1
Review Your Xero Bank Accounts

The Xero tab lists all bank accounts from your Xero organisation.

2
Map to PayTrade Accounts

For each Xero bank account, click "Manual Map" and select the corresponding PayTrade account — this can be a Cash Account, Project Trust Account (PTA), or Retention Trust Account (RTA).

3
Or Use Auto Map

Click "Auto Map" on the Mapped tab to automatically match accounts by name.

4
Or Sync New Accounts

If a Xero bank account has no PayTrade counterpart, click "Sync to PayTrade" to create one. If a PayTrade account has no Xero counterpart, click "Sync to Xero" to create one.

Important: Bank account mapping is critical for invoice and bill sync. The correct trust account must be linked before claims involving that account can sync.

Contact Mapping

Navigate to Xero Contacts on the Xero Dashboard.

1
Review Contacts

The Xero tab shows all contacts from Xero. The PayTrade tab shows all clients and suppliers from PayTrade.

2
Map Contacts

For each contact, click "Manual Map" and select the matching client or supplier. Or use "Auto Map" to match by name.

3
Import from Xero

Click "Sync to PayTrade" to create a new PayTrade client/supplier from a Xero contact.

4
Export to Xero

Click "Sync to Xero" to create a new Xero contact from a PayTrade client/supplier.

Important: Contacts must be mapped before any invoice or bill referencing them can sync. If you see a sync error about a missing contact, check this mapping first.

Project Mapping

Navigate to Xero Projects on the Xero Dashboard.

Note: Unlike bank accounts and contacts, projects map to tracking category options in Xero — not separate Xero entities. You must have a Project Tracking Category configured in Xero Settings first.
1
Review Project Options

The Xero tab shows tracking category options from your configured Project Tracking Category.

2
Map Projects

Link each Xero tracking category option to the corresponding PayTrade project.

3
Create New Options

If a PayTrade project has no Xero counterpart, click "Sync to Xero" to create a new tracking category option.

Contract Mapping

Navigate to Xero Contracts on the Xero Dashboard. The process is identical to Project Mapping but uses the Contract Tracking Category.

1
Review Contract Options

The Xero tab shows tracking category options from your configured Contract Tracking Category.

2
Map Contracts

Link each Xero tracking category option to the corresponding PayTrade contract.

3
Create New Options

Use "Sync to Xero" or "Sync to PayTrade" as needed.

The Onboarding Wizard

The Xero Dashboard presents these mappings as a 6-step onboarding wizard:

  1. Settings/Mapping — Chart of accounts, tax rates, tracking categories
  2. Bank Account Mapping
  3. Contact Mapping
  4. Project Tracking Category Mapping
  5. Contract Tracking Category Mapping
  6. Activate — Set the integration to Active status

Complete all six steps to activate your integration. You can return to any step later to update mappings.

Handling Unmapped Entities

When the daily scheduler runs and finds new entities in Xero that aren't mapped:

New Entity In XeroWhat Happens
New ProjectError log created. Click Resolve to navigate to the Project screen to create or map.
New Bank AccountError log created. Click Resolve to navigate to the Bank Account screen.
New ContactError log created. Click Resolve to navigate to the Client/Supplier screen.
New ContractError log created. Click Resolve to navigate to the Contract screen.
Tip: Check your Sync Log regularly after adding new projects, contracts, or contacts in Xero to ensure they are mapped promptly.
Note: Once all entities are mapped and the integration is activated, proceed to "Syncing Invoices and Bills with Xero" to start syncing data.

new_guides.title: Syncing Invoices and Bills with Xero
new_guides.content:
Syncing Invoices and Bills with Xero

Export payment claims from PayTrade to Xero, or import invoices and bills from Xero into PayTrade. This guide covers both directions.

Before You Begin

Before syncing invoices or bills, make sure:

  • Your Xero integration is Active
  • Account codes (invoice code, bill code, retention codes) are configured in "Xero Account Mapping and Settings"
  • Tax rates are set for invoices and bills
  • The relevant contact, project, and contract are all mapped (see "Mapping Bank Accounts, Contacts, Projects and Contracts in Xero")
Important: The system validates all mappings before syncing. If any contact, project, contract, or account code is missing, the sync will fail with a specific error in the Sync Log.

PayTrade to Xero (Exporting Claims)

PayTrade payment claims are exported to Xero as either Invoices (receivable claims) or Bills (billable claims).

How to Export

1
Create a Payment Claim

Create or confirm a payment claim in PayTrade. Only claims with status "Draft" or "Confirmed" can be exported.

2
Navigate to Xero Invoices or Bills

On the Xero Dashboard, click "View all" next to Invoices or Bills.

3
Go to the PayTrade Tab

Click the "PayTrade Invoices" or "PayTrade Bills" tab to see claims ready for export.

4
Click Sync to Xero

Select the claim and click "Sync to Xero". The system validates all mappings and creates the item in Xero.

5
Verify on Mapped Tab

The synced item appears on the "Mapped" tab with links to both the PayTrade claim and the Xero record.

What Gets Synced

PayTrade FieldXero FieldNotes
Payment Claim IDReferencePrefixed with "Claim" or "Retention claim"
Claim TypeTypeBillable = ACCPAY (Bill), Receivable = ACCREC (Invoice)
DatesDate / Due DateDirection-dependent
Total (incl. GST)Unit AmountAdjusted by retention if applicable
DescriptionDescriptionLine item description
ProjectTracking CategoryUses project tracking category
ContractTracking CategoryUses contract tracking category

Retention Handling on Export

When a claim includes retention, the system automatically splits the amount across multiple line items using the dedicated retention account codes configured in Settings. The main line item uses the invoice/bill code, and retention amounts use the retention payable/receivable codes.

Xero to PayTrade (Importing Invoices/Bills)

How to Import

1
Create in Xero

Create an invoice or bill in Xero. Make sure it includes the correct tracking categories for both Project and Contract.

2
Navigate to Xero Invoices or Bills

On the Xero Dashboard, click "View all" next to Invoices or Bills.

3
Go to the Xero Tab

Click the "Xero Invoices" or "Xero Bills" tab to see items available for import.

4
Click Sync to PayTrade

Select the item and click "Sync to PayTrade".

5
Verify in PayTrade

The system creates a payment claim in PayTrade. Check the Claims list to see the imported claim.

Import Validation

The system performs several checks before importing:

  • At least one line item is required
  • Valid tracking categories (Project and Contract) must be present on the invoice
  • Account codes and tax codes must match your PayTrade configuration
  • The total amount cannot exceed the contract size
  • The invoice must not already be mapped to an existing PayTrade claim

If retention line items are present, the system back-calculates the original item prices and retention percentages automatically.

Using Auto Map for Bulk Mapping

On the Mapped tab, click the "Auto Map" button to automatically match all unmapped invoices/bills by reference number. This is useful when you have many items to map at once.

Unmap an Invoice or Bill

If an invoice or bill was incorrectly mapped:

1
Go to the Mapped Tab

Navigate to Xero Invoices or Bills and click the Mapped tab.

2
Click Unmap

Find the incorrect mapping and click "Unmap". The items return to their respective PayTrade or Xero tabs.

Common Sync Errors

ErrorCauseFix
Contact mismatchInvoice contact does not match mapped contact for the contractUpdate the contact mapping or fix the invoice in Xero
Project mismatchInvoice tracking category does not match mapped projectUpdate the project mapping or fix the tracking category on the invoice
Contract mismatchInvoice contract tracking does not match mapped contractUpdate the contract mapping or fix the tracking category
Account code mismatchInvoice uses a different account code than configuredUpdate the account code in Xero Settings or fix the invoice
Tax code mismatchInvoice uses a different tax rate than configuredUpdate the tax code in Xero Settings or fix the invoice
S75 pending paymentA bill has a pending payment and an invoice is createdFill in the reason for the pending payment in the error log
Tip: For detailed error resolution steps, see "Understanding Xero Sync Logs and Error Resolution".

new_guides.title: Xero Payment Synchronisation
new_guides.content:
Xero Payment Synchronisation

How payments sync between PayTrade and Xero, including retention, overpayments, credit notes, and error resolution for special payment scenarios.

How Payment Sync Works

Payments in PayTrade and Xero are linked through the mapped invoices and bills they apply to. When a payment is recorded against a mapped invoice/bill in either system, it can be synced to the other.

  • Payments follow the same Draft or Approved sync preference as invoices and bills.
  • Payment sync is typically initiated manually from the Xero Dashboard or triggered when invoices/bills are synced.
  • Payments applied to synced invoices/bills in Xero are detected when the invoice is updated via webhook.

PayTrade to Xero (Exporting Payments)

1
Record a Payment in PayTrade

From the claim view page, click "Add Payment", enter the payment details, and save.

2
Navigate to Xero Payments

On the Xero Dashboard, click "View all" next to Payments.

3
Go to the PayTrade Payments Tab

Find the payment and click "Sync to Xero".

4
Verify

The payment appears on the "Mapped Payments" tab and is applied against the corresponding invoice/bill in Xero.

Important: The billable claim must be under "Add Payment" status (i.e., approved and ready for payment) before the bill payment can sync to Xero.

Xero to PayTrade (Importing Payments)

1
Record a Payment in Xero

Apply a payment to an invoice or bill in Xero.

2
Navigate to Xero Payments

On the Xero Dashboard, go to the Payments section.

3
Go to the Xero Payments Tab

Find the payment and click "Sync to PayTrade". Or use "Manual Map" to link to an existing PayTrade payment.

4
Verify

The payment is recorded in PayTrade against the mapped claim.

Important: The claim must be under "Confirm paid - matched" status for the payment to sync from Xero to PayTrade.

Retention Payments

When a claim with retention is paid:

  • The system automatically creates a retention record in the Retention List.
  • Retention amounts sync using the dedicated retention account codes configured in Xero Settings.
  • When the retention is later released, it follows the same sync process.

Special Payment Scenarios

Part Payments and Pay-Less-Full

When a partial payment is made in Xero:

  1. A $500 part payment is recorded in Xero against a $1,000 bill.
  2. PayTrade imports this as a "part payment".
  3. If the remaining $500 is later cleared using a credit note in Xero, the payment type changes to "pay less full".
  4. PayTrade detects the mismatch and triggers an "unconfirm payment" error in the Sync Log.
  5. Click "Resolve" to unconfirm the old payment. PayTrade then deletes the old record and creates a new "pay less full" record.
  6. The original part payment notice is archived and a new notice is generated for the pay-less-full payment type.

Withholding Payment Reason

When a payment is recorded as Part, Payless, Pay Zero, or Third Party in Xero:

  1. PayTrade triggers a "Withholding reason" error in the Sync Log.
  2. Click "Resolve" to navigate to the payment screen.
  3. Enter the reason for withholding payment.
  4. Once the reason is saved, the payment is recorded in PayTrade and journals/notices are generated.
Note: The withholding reason error is triggered based on the schedule setting timing configured in Xero Settings (Webhook Wait Time).

Overpayments

When a payment exceeding the invoice/bill amount is made in Xero:

  1. Example: Invoice is $1,000 but payment of $1,200 is recorded. Xero applies $1,000 and creates a $200 overpayment.
  2. PayTrade detects the discrepancy and creates an "overpayment missing" error in the Sync Log.
  3. Click "Resolve" to open the Map Claim/Payment screen.
  4. Map the overpayment to the correct claim. An overpayment record is saved in the Payment List.

Underpayments and Credit Application

When an overpayment credit from one bill is applied to another:

  1. Example: Bill 1 ($1,000) receives $1,200 payment, creating a $200 credit.
  2. Bill 2 ($500) receives $200 from the credit + $300 new payment = $500 total.
  3. PayTrade detects the mixed payment source and creates an "underpayment" error.
  4. Click "Resolve" to map the credit application correctly.

Payment Edited in Xero

If a synced payment is edited in Xero (e.g., amount changed from $1,000 to $800):

  1. PayTrade creates an error log for the payment edit.
  2. Click "Resolve" to navigate to the Payment screen.
  3. Unconfirm the payment by clearing the "Confirm paid" checkbox.
  4. PayTrade updates the payment to match the edited amount in Xero.

Payment Deleted in Xero

If a synced payment is deleted in Xero:

  1. PayTrade creates an error stating the payment type cannot be deleted.
  2. Click "Resolve".
  3. If the payment is matched to a bank transaction, you are taken to the Transaction Unmatch screen first. Unmatch the transaction.
  4. Then unconfirm and delete the payment in PayTrade.

Auto Map for Payments

Use the "Auto Map" button on the Mapped Payments tab to automatically match payments by reference. Use "Unmap" to break incorrect payment mappings.

Tip: For a complete view of all sync events, see "Understanding Xero Sync Logs and Error Resolution".

new_guides.title: Understanding Xero Sync Logs and Error Resolution
new_guides.content:
Understanding Xero Sync Logs and Error Resolution

How to read sync logs, identify issues, and resolve errors to keep your Xero integration running smoothly.

Where to Find Sync Logs

1
Open the Xero Dashboard

Navigate to Integrations and click on your Xero connection.

2
Scroll to Sync Logs

At the bottom of the dashboard, you will see the Sync Log table showing all recent sync events.

The dashboard also shows summary counts: Synced (successful) and Issues (failed).

Understanding the Sync Log Table

ColumnWhat It Shows
Date/TimeWhen the sync event occurred
TypeWhat was synced: Contacts, Invoices, Bills, Payments, Bank Accounts, Projects, Contracts
ReferenceA unique ID for this sync event (UUID from database)
StatusSucceeded (green) or Failed (red)
ActionsView details, Resolve (for failed entries)

The table supports pagination (10 records per page by default, changeable via dropdown) and sorting.

Use the "Refresh" button to reload the latest logs.

Viewing Sync Log Details

Click the view icon on any log entry to see the full details:

Succeeded Logs

  • Visual Comparison: Side-by-side table comparing PayTrade fields vs. Xero fields
  • Status Indicators: Each field is marked "Ok" (green) confirming the data matches
  • Request/Response: The actual API payload sent to/from Xero

Failed Logs

  • Error Code: A specific code identifying the type of failure
  • Error Message: A description of what went wrong
  • Visual Comparison: Side-by-side table with fields marked "Ok" (green) or "Failed" (red)
  • Resolve Button: Guides you to fix the specific issue

Resolving Errors

When you click Resolve on a failed log entry, the system determines the best fix:

Automatic Resolution

For some errors, the system can fix the issue automatically:

  • Missing entity in Xero: The system creates it automatically, then retries the sync.
  • Missing entity in PayTrade: The system creates it automatically, then retries the sync.

Redirect Resolution

For errors requiring your input, the system redirects you to the appropriate screen:

Error TypeWhere Resolve Takes YouWhat To Do
Missing required fieldsEdit page for the entityFill in the missing data and save
Invalid account codesXero Settings pageUpdate the account code mapping
Contact mismatchContact Mapping pageUpdate or create the correct mapping
Withholding reason missingPayment screenEnter the reason for withholding
Payment edited/deleted in XeroPayment screen or Unmatch screenUnconfirm and update/delete the payment
Overpayment detectedMap Claim/Payment screenMap the overpayment to the correct claim
New entity from Xero schedulerEntity creation screen (Project, Bank Account, Contact, or Contract)Create or map the new entity

Once the issue is fixed, the failed status changes to succeeded.

Scheduler Errors

The daily scheduler (runs at 1:00 PM UTC) can also generate error logs when it discovers new entities in Xero that need mapping:

  • New Project in Xero: Resolve navigates to the Project screen to create or map.
  • New Bank Account in Xero: Resolve navigates to the Bank Account screen.
  • New Contact in Xero: Resolve navigates to the Client/Supplier screen.
  • New Contract in Xero: Resolve navigates to the Contract screen.

Webhook Errors

Real-time webhook events (Contact and Invoice create/update) can also generate error logs:

  • Contact/Project/Contract mismatch: The invoice references entities that do not match the expected mappings. Fix the mappings or correct the invoice in Xero.
  • Account code or tax code mismatch: The invoice uses different codes than configured. Update Settings or fix the invoice in Xero.

Best Practices

  • Check the Sync Log at least once daily, especially after the 1:00 PM UTC scheduler runs.
  • Resolve failed entries promptly — they may block other syncs from completing.
  • When adding new projects, contracts, or contacts in Xero, map them in PayTrade promptly to avoid scheduler errors.
  • Use the "Refresh" button to see the latest state after resolving an issue.
  • If you see many of the same error type, check your Xero Settings for a misconfigured account code or tax rate.
Tip: The Issues count on the dashboard is a quick health check. If it reads 0, all recent syncs have succeeded.

updated_guides.title: Uploading and Reconciling Bank Transactions
updated_guides.content:
Uploading and Reconciling Bank Transactions

Reconciliation ensures your trust account records match your actual bank statements. This guide covers manual matching, Smart Match for automated suggestions, and error handling.

Why Reconciliation Matters

Under the BIF Act, trust account holders must perform monthly reconciliations to ensure the trust account ledger matches the bank statement. PayTrade simplifies this process by allowing you to upload bank transactions and match them against recorded claims and payments.

Step 1: Upload Bank Transactions

1
Open the Account

Navigate to Bank Accounts, then click the account you want to reconcile to open its Overview page.

2
Click "Upload Transactions"

Click the upload button to go to the transaction upload page.

3
Select CSV File

Download your bank statement as a CSV file from your bank, then upload it here. The system parses each transaction row automatically.

4
Review Imported Transactions

Check that all transactions have been imported correctly. The system shows the date, description, amount, and running balance for each.

Step 2: Match Transactions (Manual)

1
Navigate to Match Transactions

From the account overview, click "Match Transactions".

2
View Unmatched Items

The page shows two columns: unmatched bank transactions (from your CSV) and unmatched claims/payments (from your PayTrade records).

3
Select Matches

Click a bank transaction and the corresponding claim payment to match them together. The amounts should align.

4
Confirm Match

Click "Match" to confirm. The matched pair is removed from the unmatched list, and the trust account ledger is updated.

Step 3: Smart Match (Automated Suggestions)

Smart Match analyses all your unmatched transactions and automatically suggests the best payment matches, saving significant time compared to manual matching.

Enabling Smart Match

1
Toggle Smart Match On

On the Match Transactions page, toggle the "Smart Match" switch to On. Your preference is saved in your browser.

2
Wait for Analysis

The system analyses all unmatched transactions and displays match suggestions with colour-coded quality indicators.

Understanding Match Quality

BadgeMeaningAction
ExactBank transaction amount exactly matches the payment amountSafe to match with one click
NearAmounts are close but not identical (small variance)Review the variance, then use Adjust & Match
No badgeNo suitable match foundUse manual matching

Viewing Match Details

Click on any transaction row with a match suggestion to expand it. The expanded section shows the matched payment details: claim reference, payment amount, date, and the variance (if any).

One-Click Exact Match

1
Find an Exact Match

Look for transactions with a green "Exact" badge.

2
Click Match

Click the "Match" button on the expanded row. The match is applied instantly.

Match All Exact (Batch)

1
Click "Match All Exact"

Click the "Match All Exact" button at the top of the transactions list.

2
Review Results

The system matches every transaction with an exact match suggestion in a single action. A summary shows how many transactions were matched.

Tip: Use Match All Exact at the start of reconciliation to clear all the easy matches first, then handle near matches and manual matches individually.

Quick Adjust and Match (Near Matches)

When a near match is found, the bank amount and payment amount differ slightly (e.g., bank fees, rounding differences):

1
Expand the Transaction

Click the transaction row with an amber "Near" badge to see the suggested match and variance.

2
Click "Adjust & Match"

Click the "Adjust & Match" button.

3
Automatic Adjustment

The system automatically creates an adjustment payment (over-payment or under-payment) to bridge the difference, then matches the bank transaction.

4
Check the Adjustment

The adjustment payment appears in your Payments List with a note explaining the variance.

Important: Quick Adjust creates real payment records. If the adjustment was made in error, you will need to unmatch the transaction and delete the adjustment payment.

Step 4: Handle Mismatches

If a match was made incorrectly:

1
Go to Unmatch Transactions

From the account overview, click "Unmatch Transactions".

2
Select the Incorrect Match

Find the incorrectly matched transaction pair.

3
Unmatch

Click "Unmatch" to reverse the match. Both items return to the unmatched list.

Important: All bank transactions should be matched before the monthly reconciliation deadline. Unmatched transactions appear on your dashboard as alerts and may trigger compliance warnings.
Tip: If you have Bank Feeds enabled (Standard plan and above), your transactions can be imported automatically via Open Banking, eliminating the need for manual CSV uploads.
